scheme_name: Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
other_conditions: The claimant/head of the displaced persons family or their successor/heir must reside within Jammu & Kashmir.
The family must belong to one of the following categories: "Pakistan occupied Jammu & Kashmir 1947 Displaced Persons" or "Chhamb 1965 and 1971 (camp/non-camp) Displaced Persons".
benefits_summary: One-time settlement of up to Rs 5,50,000 per family for rehabilitation and livelihood support.
